overview.title: Team Overview
overview.description: Manage collaborative agent teams, track provisioned roles, and open each team workspace from here.

create.title: Create Team
create.description: Create a team from a TeamSkill package, or manually select existing agents.
create.modalDescription: Load a team from TeamSkill, or build one from existing agents and choose a Leader.
create.packagePathPlaceholder: Select or enter a TeamSkill directory or archive path
create.teamSkillDefinitionDescription: The package is the source of truth for the leader, roles, workflow, and dependencies. One TeamSkill name/version can only have one team instance.
create.manualDefinitionDescription: Select existing agents and choose exactly one Leader.
create.manualSelectedEmpty: Add at least one agent from the left.
create.manualAgentWorkspaceRequired: Selected agent needs a workspace before it can join: {{agentName}}

manualProgress.modalDescription: Follow actual creation stages. Member introductions are prepared before team configuration.
manualProgress.runningDescription: Preparing your team. Keep this window open.
manualProgress.failedDescription: Your selections are preserved. Return to edit after cleanup is confirmed.
manualProgress.unconfirmedDescription: The result is unconfirmed. Verify the team state before proceeding. Do not submit another creation request.
manualProgress.noMembers: Only the Leader is selected. No other member introductions are needed.
manualProgress.preparationNotObserved: Member introductions are ready. Their preparation was not observed for this request.
manualProgress.cleaningUp: Cleaning up this team's creation. Completion is not yet confirmed.
manualProgress.cleanupConfirmed: Cleanup is confirmed. You can return to edit your original selections.
manualProgress.cleanupUnknown: Cleanup is unconfirmed. Verify the team state before creating another team.
manualProgress.keepOpen: This window cannot be closed during creation

create.dependencyPlanUnavailable: Team dependencies could not be read. Check the TeamSkill again later.
create.existingTeamDetected: This TeamSkill version already has a team. Open the existing team instead of creating a duplicate.
create.versionChangeDescription: Current version {{currentVersion}} will be replaced by {{incomingVersion}}. The team row is kept and old run history is cleared.
create.confirmReplacement: I understand this will replace the current TeamSkill version for this team.
create.requiredDependencyBlocker: Required dependencies are missing. Resolve required skills or configure required tools before continuing.
create.noAutomaticInstallSource: This source is not a ClawHub install source. Open it, download the Skill, then import it locally.

deleteToast.deletedDescription: Runtime resources are being cleaned up in the background.
deleteToast.cleanupUnknownDescription: Runtime cleanup is not confirmed yet.

run.copyIdFailed: Could not copy the run ID. Try again.
run.emptyRuns: No runs yet. Create a run, then open the leader session and send a message to run it.
run.createFirstRunHint: This team has no run yet. Create a run, then open the leader session and send a message.
run.exportYamlNoGraph: Create or load a graph before exporting YAML.
run.exportYamlFailed: Could not export the graph YAML. Try again.

scriptReviewRuleDescriptions.passThrough: Skip checks and continue along the check-passed branch.
scriptReviewRuleDescriptions.allUpstreamCompleted: Check every incoming connection except rework: this execution must have received each branch's matching result from a completed upstream execution. Fails if there are no inputs.
scriptReviewRuleDescriptions.noBlockingGate: Check every incoming Gate connection: this execution must have received each branch's matching result from a completed upstream execution. Passes if there are no Gate connections.
scriptReviewRuleDescriptions.artifactExists: Check for an artifact reference from a direct input consumed by this execution in the same run. Does not check whether a physical file exists.

graphCanvas.humanDecisionHint: Wait here for a human decision, then follow the connection for approval, rejection, or abort.
graphCanvas.nodeDetailsDescription: View node information and task content.
graphCanvas.configureHint: Click a node or edge on the canvas to configure it.
graphCanvas.automaticPortRepair: The original port “{{port}}” is invalid; saving will use “{{replacement}}”.
graphCanvas.noPort: This node has no available port
graphCanvas.portRepairHint: Saving corrects fixed ports. Choose branches explicitly and check every connection's action. Select deletion for connections without valid ports. Only changes and selected deletions are submitted together.
graphCanvas.portRepairReconnect: This connection has no valid port. Explicitly select its deletion.
graphCanvas.noEdgeAction: No valid action connects this source branch to the target. Change the branch or delete the connection.

edgeActionDescriptions.activate: Activate the target as soon as this connection's condition is met, without waiting for other upstream nodes.
edgeActionDescriptions.rework: Start a new execution of the target. Nodes on the rework path remain subject to their total execution limits.
edgeActionDescriptions.gate: Proceed when the current executions of all source nodes connected to the target by Wait to join have completed with matching outputs. Connections using other actions are not included in this wait.
edgeActionDescriptions.finish: Usually connects to an end node. When its condition is met, it activates the target; it does not immediately end the entire run.

graphCanvas.edgeJoinGateHint: Incoming connections to a join node must use Wait to join. It proceeds only when all connected source nodes' current executions have completed with matching outputs.
graphCanvas.nodeMaxAttemptsHint: Includes the first execution. Set to 1 to disallow reruns. Connections do not change this budget.
graphCanvas.nodeMaxAttemptsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 4294967295.
graphCanvas.reworkLimitExceeded: A node on the rework path has reached its total execution limit. Check the execution budgets of nodes on this path.
graphCanvas.roleBindingRequired: Select an available member and their session.
graphCanvas.joinConfigurationHint: Wait for every connected incoming branch to complete with a result matching its connection, then continue along the joined branch. Only branches connected to this node are awaited.
graphCanvas.endConfigurationHint: Mark the end of this path without immediately stopping other branches. For a team leader summary, add a work node assigned to the leader before this node.
graphCanvas.saveGraphUnavailable: Graph save is not available for this view.
graphCanvas.startWebhookPublicBaseUrlHint: Used only to preview the URL; not saved. Configure a reverse proxy or tunnel separately; this does not expose a local port.
graphCanvas.startWebhookPublicBaseUrlInvalid: Public ingress base URL must be an http:// or https:// URL.
graphCanvas.startWebhookPublicUrlUnavailable: Shown after you enter a public ingress URL
graphCanvas.startWebhookPathPreviewHint: Send POST requests with your Webhook secret; only a masked value is shown here. This route matches by path only, so active Webhook paths must be unique.
graphCanvas.startCronExpressionHint: This expression cannot be edited with the simple form and will be saved unchanged. Select a new schedule to replace it.
graphCanvas.startTriggerHint: Manual starts with the run. Webhook waits for a request; Cron waits for its schedule.

nodePaletteDescriptions.start: Start manually, by webhook, or on a schedule
nodePaletteDescriptions.work: Assign a task to a team member
nodePaletteDescriptions.review: Have a reviewer check upstream work
nodePaletteDescriptions.join: Waits for all connected incoming branches

run.emptyWorkflow: Leader has not submitted a workflow plan yet

dependencyMissing.title: Dependencies required before this run can continue
dependencyMissing.description: Required dependencies cannot be bypassed. Install missing skills or configure missing tools, then retry the dependency check.
dependencyMissing.noAutomaticInstallSource: This source is not a ClawHub install source. Open it, download the Skill, then import it locally.
dependencyMissing.requiredToolBlocker: Required tools must be configured in OpenClaw before this run can continue.
dependencyMissing.retryAfterInstall: Retry after installing missing dependency skills.
dependencyMissing.retryNote: Retry dependency preflight after resolving dependencies.
dependencyMissing.abortNote: Abort due to unresolved TeamSkill dependencies.
